title: Kaha yeh shimr kayi ne rulaao zainab ko
body:
1. kaha yeh shimr kayi ne rulaao zainab ko
dikhao laashe baradar rulao zainab ko
<<DIVIDER>>
2. hussain imaam ko jisse kiya tha ran me shaheed
woh khoon bhara huwa khanjar dikhao zainab ko
<<DIVIDER>>
3. na ab hussain na abbas na ali akbar
nahi hai khauf kisi ka rulao zainab ko
<<DIVIDER>>
4. bandhi rasan jo kalaayi toh behaya bole
aseer hogayi dar dar phirao zainab ko
<<DIVIDER>>
5. reeda chini toh pukaari ke aye mere abbas
khuda ke waaste aakar bachao zainab ko
<<DIVIDER>>
6. yeh khaof khaa nahi sakti ali ki beti hai
har ek gaam par durra lagao zainab ko
<<DIVIDER>>
7. daro na cheenlo saidaniyo se sar se rida
seena woh teg dikhakar darao zainab ko
